checklist.why: Purpose stated, but no "use X instead" sibling (TaskPhotos, Note)
No when-not section naming an alternative
Card, header row, camera, answer line and thumbnails named; demo shows them
No atlas screen uses the Photos card; farrowing.death uses its own photo line (the TaskPhotos face)
Errors (denied, too-large), pressed and focus are specified but not rendered
Max 12 stated and shown in the full state
Inactive/full camera loses its ring (shape) as well as colour, and the answer line says why
No label or answer-line length cap; no long/zh example
Spoken labels, capture-first, viewer focus return specified
Raw px (20px offset, 8/4/3/2/1px) and no CSS-variable list
Label visible; errors say what is wrong and how to fix it
Viewer has a visible Back; Delete only while drafting
No classification and no link to TaskPhotos, which redraws it
At 375px the camera circle sits flush on the card's top, right and bottom edges; error states have no proof

variants.name: Card (well + ringed circle)
findings: Camera is 44px and tangent to the card edge

variants.name: Line (TaskPhotos: no well, outlined squircle key)
findings: Uses the key squircle that Photos says the camera must never be

findings.text: As the reference for the optional row, Photos and its only shipped face disagree: Photos rules a ringed circle "deliberately not the keys' squircle"; TaskPhotos (farrowing.death) draws an outlined squircle key with a leading camera glyph and no well. Two looks, one job.
findings.fix: Pick one face for the optional row (the farrowing line is the one in use), make the other a documented variant or retire it, and update the Photos rule to match.

findings.text: The camera is 44x44 in both faces, under the 48px glove floor, and it is the row's only target.
findings.fix: Set the camera to var(--control-height) (48px) and the empty row min-height to 48px.

findings.text: The camera circle fills the 44px row exactly, so its ring touches the card's top, right and bottom edges (no inner padding on the right).
findings.fix: Pad the card space-row-y vertically and space-row-x on the right so the camera sits inside the well.

findings.text: The optional row is not generalised: Measure renders an optional weight as a full field on Give IDs, and farrowing uses "+ Litter weight" pills. The label scale also differs (Photos 13/500, Measure 14/600).
findings.fix: Write the optional row once (label at choice-label 14/600, "Optional" muted, the action at the right, 48px) and have Photos, Measure and Note use it.

findings.text: The denied / too-large errors, pressed and focus are specified but not rendered.
Raw px, no CSS-variable list, no when-not section.
findings.fix: Tokenise, list the variables, add "When not: a fact that needs words, use Note".

proposals.name: Photos + TaskPhotos
proposals.why: Same field, two faces with contradicting rules; one should be a variant of the other

proposals.name: OptionalRow (section pattern)
proposals.why: The collapsed optional input (label · Optional · action) recurs in Photos, the Give IDs weight and farrowing's + Litter weight
